info.name: SnackRapido - Glovo Options & Pricing
info.description:
Covers the item option catalogue (api-restaurants, 4001) and server-side order pricing (api-orders, 4002).

Token capture follows the same pattern as the other SnackRapido collections (Login → pm.collectionVariables.set), but keeps two pairs because this collection switches actors mid-run:
  restaurantAccessToken / restaurantRefreshToken  — from Login Restaurant
  customerAccessToken / customerRefreshToken      — from Login Customer
IDs (restaurantId, menuItemId, optionGroupId, orderId, …) are also auto-saved by the request that creates them, same as Restaurants/Orders.

Run the whole collection in order. Requires api-users (3000), api-restaurants (4001) and api-orders (4002), plus MongoDB, Redis and RabbitMQ.

exec: // The AuthGuard rotates credentials silently: when an access token has
// expired but the refresh token is still good, it mints a new pair and
// returns them as 'accesstoken'/'refreshtoken' response headers. A client
// that ignores those headers keeps replaying the stale token.
// Unlike the other SnackRapido collections this one is logged in as two
// identities at once, so a rotated pair has to go back to whichever one
// made the call. Writing both would hand the restaurant a customer token
// and the ownership checks in folder 3 would then pass or fail for
